chapter: Childhood and early career in New Orleans
title: Singing at concert-and-ball halls with the early bands
summary: Concerts were followed by dances, with a band hired for each. She sang with musicians such as Kid Ory, King Oliver, Manuel Perez and Bunk Johnson.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: When you sang at the halls, did they have a band?

Oh, sure. Or usually it would be what they call a concert and ball, meaning the concert would start at about 8, 8.30 and last until about 10, 30, 11 o'clock. Well, when it was given in halls like that in order to make money so they could charge, you know, 50 cents and 75 cents, they had to have a band. That's where I started working with Kid Oliver and Ori and all of those different musicians, you know, P. Kool and Manuel Perez and all, you know, Bunk Johnson. That's all of that. It's in those times that I sang with those fellas. They'd hire them, you know, they'd play for the concert. Then after, they'd play for them to dance. And the dance would last maybe until 3, 4 o'clock in the morning.
